items.text: All three workshop decisions (D1: DSN passthrough for database.Connect, D2: compile-check tests for dispatch + functional tests for logging, D3: Go version upgrade only without go.work) have been incorporated into the plan. Contract Decisions section now documents each choice with rationale.

Validation gaps fixed: added Greenfield Declaration section at the top of the plan, and added 'vrooli scenario restart swarm-manager' as the final Phase 4 step plus a rollout checklist item and Definition of Done entry.
Scope section updated to explicitly note go.work is out of scope per D3. Non-goals section updated to prohibit go.work creation and backward-compatibility shims per greenfield declaration.

Remaining minor gap: risk_awareness scored 2/3 because the plan does not yet have concrete fallback steps if database.Connect's retry logic causes unexpected behavior with SQLite WAL pragmas. This is low-likelihood but could be addressed during execution by testing with a short timeout and verifying pragma application post-connect.

plan_updates: Incorporated all 3 workshop decisions into Contract Decisions section. Added Greenfield Declaration section. Added Phase 4 with vrooli scenario restart step. Updated Scope, Non-goals, Rollout/Validation Checklist, and Definition of Done to reflect decisions and fix validation warnings.
